scenes.text: Claude built an equipment tracker, an Asset Panda alternative. You paste in your old laptop spreadsheet here. But my spec emailed the holder on every check-out, and an import counted as one.
Now an import just records who has what. Only a real hand-over sends the email, like this one to Priya.
That was one of eighty-two gaps this build found. All twenty-one checks passed, and every gap is fixed.
